notes.title: 16 HOURS LEFT For the Noiramore Academy Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello my psyquine students!
The Noiramore Academy Kickstarter only has 16 hours left! I am extremely happy to say that we are FULLY FUNDED! Next, we are trying to reach our stretch goals, the first of which is for full voice acting!

Check out the Kickstarter page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inkroseinc/noiramore-academy-a-mystery-adventure-game]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inkroseinc/noiramore-academy-a-mystery-adventure-game[/url]

Thank you all so much for your support thus far! We are super excited to continue development on this title!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45034554/5edce2bb56387f11ae30121882139ae95de9c98d.png[/img]

-Anastasia

notes.title: 6 DAYS LEFT For the Noiramore Academy Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello my psyquine students!
The Noiramore Academy Kickstarter only has 6 days left for funding, and we are currently 65% funded. We need all the support we can get to be able to make this game happen. If you enjoyed the demo and want to see more of Judith, her friends, and the mystery that surrounds them, please consider checking out the reward tiers and helping us out. 
I also made a little animation with Becky to talk about the Kickstarter further:
[previewyoutube=yf6c-a3BwZY;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out the Kickstarter page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inkroseinc/noiramore-academy-a-mystery-adventure-game]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inkroseinc/noiramore-academy-a-mystery-adventure-game[/url]

Thank you all so much for your support thus far!

-Anastasia

notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.content:
## Bug Fixes
* Fixed window interaction range
* Improved Object dither-out distance
* Improved Ratio calculation for Chalk mini-game

## Changes
* New Setting: Camera Lag Toggle
* New Setting: Fullscreen Toggle
* Revamped sound effects: Puzzle Jingle, Gem Slotting
* Changed Hunting Tapestry to make cavehounds stand out more
* Changed history book texture to label the canyon and river
* Changed difficulty of chalk minigame

notes.title: Demo Patch #2
notes.content:
# Bugs Fixes
* Fixed Movies looping
* Fixed Camera Sensitivity setting
* Smoothed mouse movement on Chalk Puzzle

## Changes
* Added motion blur setting
* Added option to abandon Chalk & Sewing puzzles

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.content:
## Bug Fixes
* Fixed controller input breaking on battle puzzle when exiting "Restart Confirmation"
* Fixed repeating line about not know battle terms after getting note hint
* Fixed wrong objective displaying after portrait puzzle
* Fixed Gina showing up incorrectly in final cutscene
* Fixed begin able to give the Lunch Token too early

## Changes
* Added "Hint" option to Battle Puzzle
* Changed Sewing Puzzle Textures for User Experience improvements
